identity.paletteIntent: Newsprint cream and ink by day, a blacked out convoy road by night. Madder red from French trousers as the accent, grey blue horizon for French forces, taximeter brass for the taxi story.
identity.typographyIntent: Bodoni Moda italic headlines in the manner of a 1914 Paris front page, Newsreader for reading, DM Mono for dispatches, dates and the meter.
textureLanguage: paper map on a wooden sand table
identity.shapeLanguage: Front page columns and double rules, square plates, wooden army blocks with a facing wedge.
motionGrammar: Army blocks slide between dates on student input and the camera follows their center.
Taxis and a staff car loop along their routes only while their date is showing.
Reduced motion jumps straight to each state.
interactionSignature: Step a sand table through seven dates and watch the gap open and close.
Load and drive one taxi, then predict how many soldiers all the taxis carried.
Judge battle stories as legend or record.
identity.densityRhythm: Short front page, one long story column, then a large table, then the night section, then documents and cards.
identity.archivalBehavior: Period Library of Congress photographs labeled by collection and date, never colorized or generated. The sand table and the taxi are labeled reconstructions.
identity.endingLanguage: Decide whether the Marne was a win for France, using one fact from the page.
identity.seriesThread: Front Lines strip under the nameplate, the ledger of costs, and the before and next handoff in the footer, shared with every WWI battle ByteSize.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Bain News Service glass negatives of Paris and French soldiers in 1914, plus the red of the 1914 French uniform.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Hard rules and double rules from newspaper layout. Plates sit on panel paper with a thin border.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Date tabs like a dateline, a brass taximeter readout, and stamp style verdict tags.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Columns for story text, wide stages for the 3D table and the taxi.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Ordinary scrolling. The table and taxi change only when a student acts.
